diagnostics.message: aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook is forced to be created AFTER aws_lambda_function.webhook because its name references aws_lambda_function.webhook.function_name. AWS Lambda auto-creates the /aws/lambda/<function_name> log group when the function is provisioned/first invoked, so the explicit log group (with its retention/kms/class settings) can collide with the auto-created one (ResourceAlreadyExistsException) — especially since both resources are subject to replacement via replace_triggered_by on null_resource.github_app_parameters. The function should be created after the log group (per the official aws_lambda_function docs: "Ensure log group exists before function"). Fixing this requires computing the log group name from var.config.prefix instead of the function attribute, and ordering the function after the log group; no single attribute reference on the function can express it cleanly (adding logging_config.log_group = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.webhook.name would be an option but also requires renaming the log group, so a bare depends_on on the function is the pragmatic fix).

aws_lambda_function.webhook configures vpc_config (when var.config.lambda_subnet_ids/lambda_security_group_ids are set) but does not depend on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role. Lambda function creation with VPC config requires the execution role to already carry the EC2 CreateNetworkInterface/DescribeNetworkInterfaces permissions granted by AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole; if the function is created before the attachment, CreateFunction can fail. Both resources are gated on the same var.config conditions, so the attachment always exists when vpc_config is set — the missing ordering just needs a bare depends_on (the attachment is counted and offers no attribute to reference).
